shots.action: Medium close-up on the high kadamba branch, camera at branch height, eye level with Krishna, locked off: Krishna relaxed and looking out, eyes lifted toward the dark water below, face calm before the leap, brows relaxed, mouth soft; one hand resting on the branch; the kadamba leaves around him, the trunk out of focus; sash and curls still.
shots.light: Light: dawn, low sun from screen left, sky haze, cool green shade under the leaves.

shots.light: Light: dawn, low sun from screen left, sky haze, cool green shade under the leaves.

shots.light: Light: dawn, low sun from screen left, the sun dulled by miasma, colour drained toward grey-violet.
